verses.restored: God, you are my God; I seek you earnestly. My soul thirsts for you; my flesh longs for you in a dry and weary land where there is no water.

familiar.text: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

modern.text: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.

verses.restored: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

familiar.text: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

modern.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.

original.text: כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑יךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

familiar.text: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

modern.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.

verses.restored: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

modern.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
